description: This file defines the TraceMiddleware class used for tracing state changes between middlewares in the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes methods for logging request and response details, handling sensitive data scrubbing, and managing HTTP debug information.

classes.name: TraceMiddleware
classes.description: A class for tracing and logging middleware state changes, including request/response details and sensitive data scrubbing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TraceMiddleware with configuration options and an optional AWS Service object.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Returns a callable middleware that wraps command execution for tracing.

methods.name: stepOutput
methods.description: Logs the output step details and execution time.

methods.name: compareStep
methods.description: Compares previous and current step data, logs differences.

methods.name: commandArray
methods.description: Converts a command object into an array with redacted parameters.

methods.name: requestArray
methods.description: Converts a request object into an array with relevant details.

methods.name: responseArray
methods.description: Converts a response object into an array with relevant details.

methods.name: resultArray
methods.description: Converts a result object into an array.

methods.name: exceptionArray
methods.description: Converts an exception into an array with detailed info, including AWS-specific data if applicable.

methods.name: compareArray
methods.description: Recursively compares two arrays or values, recording differences.

methods.name: str
methods.description: Converts a value to string, handling exceptions and dumping complex types.

methods.name: streamStr
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a stream, respecting size limits.

methods.name: createHttpDebug
methods.description: Initializes HTTP debug resource in command if enabled.

methods.name: flushHttpDebug
methods.description: Outputs and closes HTTP debug resource.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Logs a message, applying scrubbing if enabled.

methods.name: getRedactedArray
methods.description: Redacts sensitive command parameters based on service shapes.
